verdict.rationale: Rive ships official, open-source runtime SDKs for loading and controlling .riv files in apps, games, and websites. The GitHub runtime repo, per-runtime migration guides (web, React, React Native, Flutter, Apple), a feature-support matrix, and documented web data-binding APIs all back this up. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs, and any SDK guidance aimed at AI or agent workflows (the root llms.txt returns 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Rive runtimes are open-source libraries that allow you to load and control your animations in apps, games, and websites.
Loads .riv files, advances state machines and animations, and draws via the abstract Renderer interface.
Rive maintains per-runtime migration guides for major versions, including explicit deprecations with a stated last-updated version and replacement
You can use the same exported file across supported runtimes, including web, mobile, game engines, and other platforms.
A feature-support matrix maps editor features to runtime versions per platform
